after_fields.mode_of_action_notes: CURATOR: Ansamycin antibiotic from Streptomyces collinus that inhibits bacterial nucleic acid synthesis and acts as a sulfhydryl-reactive vitamin K antagonist in Gram-positive bacteria; cysteine and other sulfhydryl compounds reverse growth inhibition by nucleophilic Michael addition to the naphthoquinone chromophore (Balerna et al. 1969, DOI:10.1007/BF00409749, PMID:4978971; Okabe et al. 1985, DOI:10.7164/antibiotics.38.230, PMID:3997669).

after_molecular_targets.experimental_context: Gram-positive bacterial growth-inhibition reversal by vitamin K and sulfhydryl compounds (cysteine, glutathione) and nucleic acid synthesis inhibition assays in Bacillus megaterium and mouse leukemia L5178Y cells (Balerna et al. 1969, DOI:10.1007/BF00409749, PMID:4978971; Okabe et al. 1985, DOI:10.7164/antibiotics.38.230, PMID:3997669).

evidence.snippet: Okabe et al. demonstrated that naphthomycin A inhibits nucleic acid synthesis and that sulfhydryl compounds such as cysteine and dithiothreitol reverse its biological activity via nucleophilic addition to the naphthoquinone moiety.
evidence.notes: Okabe et al. 1985 (J Antibiot 38:230-235; PMID:3997669) established that naphthomycin A inhibits nucleic acid synthesis and is inactivated by sulfhydryl-group nucleophilic addition to its naphthoquinone chromophore.

Balerna et al. 1969 (Arch Mikrobiol 65:303-317; PMID:4978971) isolated naphthomycin from Streptomyces collinus and characterized its Gram-positive antibacterial activity and competitive antagonism by vitamin K and cysteine.

after_fields.mode_of_action_notes: CURATOR: Pentacyclic quinone polyketide antibiotic from Streptomyces resistomycificus that complexes divalent cations (Mg2+) required by bacterial DNA-dependent RNA polymerase and DNA polymerase, inhibiting bacterial RNA and DNA biosynthesis (Haupt et al. 1975, DOI:10.1002/jobm.19750150603, PMID:1106088; Jakobi et al. 2002, DOI:10.1021/ja026369d, PMID:12033902).

after_molecular_targets.target_label: bacterial DNA-dependent RNA and DNA biosynthesis
after_molecular_targets.experimental_context: Macromolecular precursor incorporation and purified bacterial RNA and DNA polymerase divalent-cation (Mg2+) complexation assays in Bacillus subtilis and Escherichia coli (Haupt et al. 1975, DOI:10.1002/jobm.19750150603, PMID:1106088; Jakobi et al. 2002, DOI:10.1021/ja026369d, PMID:12033902).

evidence.snippet: Haupt et al. demonstrated that resistomycin inhibits bacterial RNA and DNA synthesis in Bacillus subtilis and cell-free polymerase systems by interacting with Mg2+ ions required for RNA and DNA polymerase activity.
evidence.notes: Haupt et al. 1975 (Z Allg Mikrobiol 15:415-424; PMID:1106088) established that resistomycin blocks bacterial RNA and DNA synthesis via Mg2+-dependent inhibition of RNA and DNA polymerase reactions.
Jakobi et al. 2002 (J Am Chem Soc 124:6319-6325; PMID:12033902) characterized the discoid polyketide structure and biosynthesis of resistomycin in Streptomyces resistomycificus.

Funabashi et al. 2000 (J Antibiot 53:199-201; PMID:10805582) isolated kendomycin (TAN-2162) from Streptomyces violaceoruber and reported its potent antibacterial activity against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.
